name: L12 · 这个季节天气变化很快
titleCn: 这个季节天气变化很快
titleEn: The weather changes rapidly in this season

title.en: Chatting while walking on the street

intro.cn: 在街上，王一飞和白家月边走边聊。
intro.en: On the street, Wang Yifei and Bai Jiayue were chatting while walking.

questions.q: 她们今天为什么不去公园？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 王老师，您看，这条街上的树都开花了。
lines.en: Ms. Wang, look! The trees along this street are in bloom.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 上周我去公园坐船了，公园里的花也开了。
lines.en: Last week, I went boating in the park—the flowers there were blooming, too.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 天气这么好，下午我也想去公园坐船。
lines.en: The weather is so nice. I'd like to go boating in the park this afternoon.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 去吧！今天是工作日，人应该不多。
lines.en: Go ahead! It's a weekday, so there probably won't be many people.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 您有时间吗？我想跟您一起去。
lines.en: Do you have time? I'd like to go with you.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我今天下午有课，不能去太远的地方。
lines.en: I have classes this afternoon, so I can't go too far.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 那咱们换一天去？
lines.en: Then shall we go another day？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 行。或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
lines.en: Sure—either tomorrow or the day after. I'll give you a call.

postQuestions.q: 上周王一飞去公园做什么了？
她们可能什么时候去公园？

title.en: Taking a walk on the street

intro.cn: 在街上，王一飞和白家月一起散步。
intro.en: On the street, Wang Yifei and Bai Jiayue were taking a walk together.

questions.q: 新闻里说今天会是什么天气？
这个季节的天气是什么样的？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 刚才还是大晴天呢，怎么突然就刮起风来了？
lines.en: It was sunny just a moment ago. How did it suddenly get so windy？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 好像新闻里说今天有雨。
lines.en: I think the news said it's going to rain today.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 啊？我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
lines.en: Really? I usually keep an umbrella in my bag, but I didn't bring it today.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我可以借给你，我车里有一把伞和一件雨衣。
lines.en: I can lend you one—I have both an umbrella and a raincoat in my car.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 谢谢，希望下午天气能变好。
lines.en: Thanks! I hope the weather clears up this afternoon.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 这个季节天气变化很快。
lines.en: The weather changes quickly at this time of year.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 雨已经下起来了，咱们快点儿走吧。
lines.en: It's already starting to rain—let's hurry and go.

postQuestions.q: 白家月今天带雨伞了吗？
王一飞可以借给白家月什么？
她们现在要做什么？为什么？

words.en: for sth with a handle, or with its legs parted, etc.

title.en: Taking shelter from the rain in the classroom

intro.cn: 在教室里，王一飞和白家月躲雨。
intro.en: In the classroom, Wang Yifei and Bai Jiayue were taking shelter from the rain.

questions.q: 王一飞来这里多长时间了？
白家月是怎么知道今年很多地方都下雪少的？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 您来这里已经一年多了，习惯了吧？
lines.en: You've been here for over a year now—have you gotten used to it？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 别的早就习惯了，就是天气我还不太习惯。
lines.en: I've gotten used to most things, but I'm still not quite used to the weather.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 为什么？您不喜欢这里的天气吗？
lines.en: Why? Don't you like the weather here？

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我觉得冬天太冷了。
lines.en: I think the winters are too cold.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 冬天虽然冷，但是下雪的时候特别漂亮。
lines.en: Winter may be cold, but it's especially beautiful when it snows.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 我也喜欢雪。北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
lines.en: I like snow too. It usually snows often in Beijing, but I heard it only snowed once this year.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 我没关注过北京的天气，但是新闻里说过，今年冬天很多地方雪下得都少了。
lines.en: I haven't kept up with Beijing's weather, but the news said that many places have had less snow this winter.

postQuestions.q: 王一飞对什么还不太习惯？
白家月为什么喜欢冬天？

intro.cn: 在家里，王一飞在写日记。
intro.en: At home, Wang Yifei was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 王一飞喜欢哪个城市的四季？
王一飞觉得北京哪个季节最舒服？

lines.cn: 我离开北京到这里工作一年多了。
lines.en: It's been over a year since I left Beijing to work here.

lines.cn: 这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。
lines.en: After living here for over a year, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons.

lines.cn: 北京的春天最舒服，天气不冷不热。
lines.en: Spring in Beijing is the most pleasant—it's neither too cold nor too hot.

lines.cn: 夏天白天很热，但是晚上比较凉快。
lines.en: Summer days are very hot, but the evenings are fairly cool.

lines.cn: 秋天树上的叶子都变成了红色、黄色，非常漂亮。
lines.en: In autumn, the leaves on the trees all turn red and yellow—it's very beautiful.

lines.cn: 冬天不但冷，而且风很大，我最不喜欢冬天。
lines.en: Winter is not only cold but also very windy—it's my least favorite season.

lines.cn: 每个人都有自己最喜欢的季节，你最喜欢哪个季节呢？
lines.en: Everyone has their own favorite season—which one do you like the most？

postQuestions.q: 北京的夏天是什么样的？
北京的秋天是什么样的？
王一飞为什么最不喜欢冬天？

grammar.en: The Alternative Complex Sentence “或者……，或者……”
grammar.note: 选择复句“或者……，或者……”表示在两个或多个可能的选项中选择一个，多用于口语。
grammar.noteEn: The alternative complex sentence “或者……，或者……” indicates a choice between two or more possibilities. It is commonly used in colloquial speech.

items.c: 或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
items.en: Either tomorrow or the day after—I'll give you a call.

items.c: 我们或者今天去电影院看电影，或者明天在家看电影。
items.en: We'll either go to the cinema today or watch a movie at home tomorrow.

items.c: 晚饭你自己选，或者吃中国菜，或者吃日本菜，或者吃泰国菜。
items.en: Choose dinner yourself—either Chinese, Japanese, or Thai food.

grammar.en: Extended Use of the Complement of Direction (2)
grammar.note: 趋向补语“起来”用在动词或形容词后，表示动作开始进行或进入一个新的状态。如果动词带宾语，宾语应该在“起”和“来”的中间。
grammar.noteEn: The complement of direction “起来” is used after a verb or an adjective to indicate the start of an action or entry into a new state. If the verb takes an object, the object should be placed between “起” and “来”.

items.en: It has already started to rain.
The weather has gotten hot recently.
How did it suddenly get so windy？

grammar.note: 范围副词“就”用在带有数量词的动词前面，表示说话人认为数量少、程度轻、时间短等意义。“就”用在名词或名词性主语前，表示例外情况。
grammar.noteEn: The adverb of scope “就” is used before a verb accompanied by a numeral-measure word to indicate that the speaker considers the quantity to be small, the degree low, or the duration short. “就” placed before a noun or a nominal subject indicates an exception.

items.c: 北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
items.en: It usually snows often in Beijing, but I heard it only snowed once this year.

items.c: 他昨天就看了十分钟书。
items.en: Yesterday he only read for ten minutes.

items.c: 我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
items.en: I keep an umbrella in my bag every day—only today I didn't bring it.

items.c: 你们点的菜都挺好吃的，就我点的这个菜不太好吃。
items.en: All the dishes you ordered are quite good—only the one I ordered isn't very tasty.

grammar.en: Extended Use of the Complement of Direction (3)
grammar.note: 趋向补语“下来”用在动词后，表示完成一个费时、费力、需要克服一定困难的动作行为。
grammar.noteEn: The complement of direction “下来” is used after a verb to indicate the completion of an action requiring considerable time, effort, or the overcoming of difficulties.

items.c: 这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。
items.en: After living here for over a year, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons.

items.c: 这半年练下来，他画画的水平提高了不少。
items.en: After half a year of practice, his painting has improved a lot.

items.c: 5000米的长跑比赛，没想到我跑下来了。
items.en: I never thought I could finish the 5,000-meter race.

tips.note: “不A不B”表示某个状态介于A和B之间，既不是A，也不是B，表达适中的程度。常用的有：不大不小、不多不少、不胖不瘦、不冷不热等。
tips.noteEn: “不A不B” indicates a state between A and B (neither A nor B), expressing a moderate degree. Common examples are 不大不小, 不多不少, 不胖不瘦, 不冷不热, and so on.

items.c: 北京的春天最舒服，天气不冷不热。
items.en: Spring in Beijing is the most pleasant—it's neither too cold nor too hot.

items.c: 这雨伞不大不小，可以放在书包里。
items.en: This umbrella is neither too big nor too small—it fits in a schoolbag.

这______雨伞不大不小，可以放在书包里。
我把这件雨衣______给你吧，我开车不需要穿。
这个______北京不冷不热，很多人都在这个时候来旅游。
B：不是，每年就二月雪最多。
A：______下大雨了，天气凉快了很多。
B：没错，每天都能这么凉快就好了。
A：这几天天气不好，我怕下午的飞机会晚点。
B：放心吧，我一直在______天气，下午是晴天。

B：是的，太漂亮了！我是第一次见到这么大的雪，咱们出去看看吧。

classroomActivity.description: 两人一组，围绕以下问题讨论现在住的城市。回答时，使用本课所学的词语和语言点。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: Work in pairs to discuss the city you currently live in based on the following questions. When responding, use the words and language points covered in this lesson.

topics.cn: 你在现在的城市已经住了多久了？
在这里住下来以后，你习惯了吗？
这个城市一年有几个季节？每个季节的天气是什么样的？
现在是哪个季节？人们在这个季节喜欢做什么？
你最喜欢哪个季节？为什么？
你觉得今年的天气和以前比，有什么不一样？
